in_marathi.name: Satypal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Satypal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Satya', meaning 'truth', 'reality' and 'honesty'. The name 'Satpal' is a combination of 'Satya' and 'Pal' which means 'protector'. This name signifies a truthful and loyal protector.
